spec.description: Generative router SFT (plan-002 generative version) based on ablation-b success. Uses implicit token generation ([SIMULATE]/raw) instead of classification head. Upsample minority to 1:1 + WeightedRandomSampler.
spec.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1 WANDB_MODE=offline HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 python src/training/generative_router_sft.py train --data_dir data/plan-004-implicit --model_name /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B --epochs 3 --batch_size 4 --gradient_accumulation_steps 8 --output_dir checkpoints/plan-002-generative-v1 --seed 42 --gpu_id 0
